Towers/Alchemist Tower.description: Throws flasks of acid onto groups: the acid keeps eating them for a few turns, stacking.

Towers/Archer Tower.description: Shoots enemies up to 2 tiles away and can move between shots.

Towers/Ballista Tower.description: A siege bow: it hits hard from far away, but cannot shoot what stands next to it.

Towers/Cannon Tower.description: Slow and heavy: a shell every third turn that wrecks a whole group. It cannot fire at what is next to it.

Towers/Drummer Tower.description: A drummer beating a war drum: towers within 2 tiles of it hit 3 harder, and Rally speeds them up for a while.

Towers/Guardian Tower.description: A sturdy tower that taunts enemies into hitting it instead of the others.

Towers/Mage Tower.description: Slow but hits groups: Firebolt burns everything around the tile it hits.

Towers/Priest Tower.description: Keeps the others standing: Mend heals the most hurt tower.

Towers/Wisp Tower.description: A spirit tower: it zaps from afar and blinks across the field, over walls and roads.
